text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her debut race behind us, it's time to decide on Air Groove's next goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The most fitting race for the Empress would be…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume who conquers the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies is crowned as the queen of the junior year. What race could be a better fit for Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All the same, I wonder what Air Groove's own take is. I head out to find her and ask.

text_block_list.name: Student Council Member
text_block_list.text: I've finished checking the academy equipment, Vice President. Here's the list I compiled.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Thank you. You can leave the remaining checks to me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Phew… Next on the agenda is to sort the documents in the student council office.
choice_data_list: Looks like you're hard at work.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh, hello.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Unless the matter is urgent, can you leave me be? I need to organize some documents in the student council office.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Excuse me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I want to talk to Air Groove about our future plans as soon as possible, so I decide to help her clear her schedule.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You want to help so that I finish up quicker? …Heh. You're getting better at this.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Enough dawdling, then. Let's get to the student council office. If you insist on helping, I'm going to work you to the bone.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh? So we have a guest. I'm sorry for not being able to prepare some tea.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I brought my trainer to help with organizing the documents. I assume it won't be a problem?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Of course not. The timing could not be better, in fact.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: A member of the groundskeeping committee was looking for you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: She seemed quite on edge. Would you mind talking to her directly?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: While you attend to that, I will help your trainer work through these documents.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: While you attend to that, I will help your trainer work through these documents.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I see. I think I know what the issue might be. I'll head out now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If you'll excuse me…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In an unexpected turn of events, I'm left alone with Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Very well—shall we get started?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to Symboli Rudolf's remarkably deft handling, we get through what seemed like a mountain of documents far quicker than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You have my thanks. I'm glad we were able to finish before Air Groove returned.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "Letting" you help, you say? Interesting. That speaks volumes about your relationship.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Speaking of which… There's something I would like to ask you regarding Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (President?)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (What could those two possibly be talking about?)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: As you know, Air Groove works passionately, both in the performance of her student council administrative tasks and also in caring for the younger students.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: At the same time, she performed splendidly at her debut and spares no effort in achieving her own goals.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I imagine that she will continue to work tirelessly for other Umamusume while also keeping herself disciplined as she aims for ever greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It is a path paved with thorns. One in which it is all too possible to stumble along the way.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You watch over her from a closer vantage than anyone else. As such, I'd like to ask you…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Is Air Groove pushing herself too hard?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf's query is accompanied by an intense stare.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Under her gaze, I remember what Air Groove said after her debut…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This bears repeating—don't get lax. And…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Stay with me, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As her trainer, there is only one answer to give.
choice_data_list: I believe in the path Air Groove is walking.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: True strength can move mountains, as they say. You and Air Groove are more alike than I realized.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: My apologies if I overstepped. Thank you again for your help today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I will tell Air Groove that you have returned to your office.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as bidden, I head back to my office to wait for Air Groove, only to find…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
choice_data_list: Oh, hey—when did you get here?
Oh, hey—when did you get here?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's… not important. You wished to discuss our plans, did you not?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I want to take on the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll seize victory and be queen of the junior year.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If I manage that, then… the president's anxieties will be assuaged.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If she's worried about me, then that means I'm not up to my ideal standards as the Empress.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I realize that Air Groove must have overheard my conversation with Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But looking at the troubled expression on her face, I feel it may not be the time to pry. Right now, I have to do my job as her trainer.
choice_data_list: I was thinking the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh. Looks like you understand me somewhat.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'd like to talk about your behavior today.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You… helped me out, in your own way. I suppose I owe you my thanks.
choice_data_list: You can count on me anytime.
You can count on me anytime.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Let's not be foolish, now. You might be giving yourself too much credit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next goal is to win the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies and make Air Groove the queen of the junior year!
